THAT IS THE ROUND'S ONE REAL MATCHER FINDING: `namesTarget`'s acronym branch requires the parenthetical to be all upper case (`/^[\p{Lu}\p{N}][\p{Lu}\p{N}.\- ]*$/`), so `(SDDS)` fires and `(SDDS Plus)` never can — the lower-case 'lus' disqualifies it. Not fixed here: it is a change to the matcher and needs Thomas's ruling, and it is recorded in HANDOFF. WHY THESE ARE SELF-DECLARED AND THE ROUND-7 EDGES ARE NOT: rule 19 judges by authorship, and an NSDP is written by the country's own statistical system. WHAT THE EDGE ASSERTS, since the corpus has ruled twice that a dissemination tier is a country-wide status and not a property of one publication (Guatemala, centralamerica-new-grok-2026-08.json; Argentina, this round's round-7 basis): the claim here is not the country's membership, it is that the SDDS prescribes which data categories THIS page carries, at what periodicity and with what timeliness.
